# felicabrera.com

## About
Personal site of Felipe Cabrera, an engineering student in Uruguay working on cybersecurity (CTFs) and data/ML software. "Rompo sistemas para entender cómo protegerlos, y construyo software que convierte datos complejos en algo que cualquiera puede usar."

## Key Sections
- Home (/): work, achievements, press, writing and contact
- Case study (/trabajo/hea): HEA, Habitable Exoplanet Analyzer
- Blog (/blog): technical writing (coming soon)

## Contact
- Email: me@felieppe.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/felicabrera/
- GitHub: https://github.com/felicabrera/
- X: https://x.com/thefelieppe
- Instagram: http://instagram.com/feli_cabrera

## Projects
- **HEA - Habitable Exoplanet Analyzer** (2025): exoplanet detection and habitability assessment with explainable AI (SHAP), Streamlit UI and FastAPI backend. ~94% accuracy. NASA Space Apps Challenge 2025. [Case study](https://felicabrera.com/trabajo/hea) · [GitHub](https://github.com/felicabrera/hea)
- **Calorflow** (2025): API and UI for preprocessing, training and predictions for the ANCAP Data Challenge 2025. Docker Compose, Celery workers, MLflow checkpoints. [GitHub](https://github.com/felicabrera/calorflow)

## Achievements
- **NASA Space Apps Challenge** (2025): 1st national place, Uruguay.
- **OEA Cyber Challenge Uruguay** (2026): 3rd national place with team "Never be Frog".
- **UTE Data Challenge** (2025): CCR recognition, energy consumption optimization with neural networks.
